title: game isnt responding to any of my controls

posts.author: protoCollector
posts.body:
ive been using rpg maker 2003 for 2 or 3 years now and ive never encountered this glitch before. but recently when i playtest my project, i can get past the title screen just fine but my character will not respond to any of my controls. i cant even open the menu. its not a tileset issue, i made the correct ones passable but even still i cannot move. i tried resetting my keyboard and it did nothing. i tried restarting my computer, uninstalling rpg maker 2003 and reinstalling it and it did nothing
please tell me what i need to do, ive been working on this game for over a year and i cant lose all my progress

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
If you can select the choices in the
Title Menu/Main Title
to start the game then you probably created an event with automatic triggering in the
Common Events
or in the starting map.

posts.author: Cherry
posts.body:
Check all your events (on map and common events) for any autorun events that never end. They will block user interaction!
(Sorry, when I asked for live debugging on Steam discussions, my mind was framed on this being the keyboard issue because you posted in that thread, but this seems to be a different problem anyway.)
